name: Grim Embrace

description.content: Whenever you Hook a Survivor for the first time, earn [1] Token.
Whenever you move [16m] away from the hooked Survivor all Generators are blocked for [10s].
After reaching [4] Tokens, when you move [16m] away from the hooked Survivor:

items: You see the Obsession's Aura for [10s].

quote: "Are we nothing but prisoners to our sorrow?" -Carmina Mora
